# Copies of a keyed loop keep apart where an element's identity already reads
# like a repeat's suffix, on every target. `["a", "a", "a#1"]` handed out
# `a#1` twice, and on bubbletea the second and third rows shared their count;
# the interpreter suffixed `~1` instead, so `["a", "a", "a~1"]` collided there.
# Each identity has its `#`s doubled before a repeat is suffixed `#n`, in
# lower's __identified and the interpreter's iterationID alike.

sngl test --platform=none hash.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html hash.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go hash.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go hash.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go hash.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin hash.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none tilde.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html tilde.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go tilde.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go tilde.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go tilde.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin tilde.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'
-- hash.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component row(label string) ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.button #b(text="{label}:{n}", @click { n += 1 })
}

component page ui.node {
    var names list[string] = ["a", "a", "a#1"]
    ui.vbox {
        for var name = names {
            row #r(label=name)
        }
    }
}

func testCopiesApart(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.r[2].b.text == "a#1:0")
    c.r[1].b.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].b.text == "a:1")
    t.assert(c.r[2].b.text == "a#1:0")
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
-- tilde.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component row(label string) ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.button #b(text="{label}:{n}", @click { n += 1 })
}

component page ui.node {
    var names list[string] = ["a", "a", "a~1"]
    ui.vbox {
        for var name = names {
            row #r(label=name)
        }
    }
}

func testCopiesApart(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.r[2].b.text == "a~1:0")
    c.r[1].b.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].b.text == "a:1")
    t.assert(c.r[2].b.text == "a~1:0")
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
